description: Verify that DUT's ICMP Echo Reply carries an IPv4 header whose Source Address equals one of DUT's configured IPv4 addresses — Reply must come from a real, owned address
approach:
[Objective]
A Reply with src_ip not matching any DUT iface address would confuse the requester (cache poisoning, return-path failure). DUT's outgoing-interface IP must appear as the IPv4 source.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request (target_ip=DUT IP)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: Echo Reply
      - src_ip ∈ DUT's configured IPv4 addresses   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply src_ip matches a DUT-owned address.

[Fail condition]
Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window. (Wrong src_ip would be rare — covered implicitly by Reply absence here.)

verdicts.Pass: Reply src_ip matched a DUT-owned address — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
